text:
Sara (CS): Kickoff: CedarTech onboarding. Quick sync to align stakeholders, success criteria, and 30/60/90 timeline. @Alex P can you confirm PM sponsor? @Mike L for technical lead?
Alex P (PM): Yep, I'm PM sponsor. Stakeholders: Natasha R (Customer Success), Omar K (Integration), Priya S (Security).
Mike L (SE): I'll be TL for the integration. Prefer Wed mornings for deep-dive calls. I'll need API keys + a sample dataset.
Natasha R (CedarTech): Thanks — CedarTech here. Goals: pilot NLU for support triage, <=200ms p95, and 60% resolution automation within 90 days. We'll share dataset by EOD Friday.
Sara (CS): Noted goals. Success metrics: p95 latency target, automation lift %, and churn risk <15%. Proposed 30/60/90: week1 setup + training, week3 pilot, week8 scale. Thoughts?
Mike L (SE): One ask: can we enable a Dedicated trial for 2 weeks to test latency? cc @infra
infra-bot: infra-request created: REQ-4521. ETA: initial capacity provision in 3 business days.
Alex P (PM): We should schedule stakeholder alignment meeting. Propose Thu 10am PT. I'll send calendar invite. Agenda: roles, data handoff, canary plan, rollback.
Sara (CS): Assigning owners: Data ingestion - Mike; Security review - Priya; Success playbook - Natasha; Eval suite - Sara. I'll add checklist in shared doc: https://redwood.app/s/cedartech/onboard-checklist
Natasha R (CedarTech): :thumbsup: We'll prepare acceptance prompts and sample logs. Quick Q — any constraints on PII? We need guidance.
Alex P (PM): Yes, follow our standard PII redaction checklist. Sara, can you share?
Sara (CS): Sharing doc and checklist now. Also outlining a compact 30/60/90:
```
30d: infra + data ingestion + basic evals
60d: pilot live, measure latency & automation lift
90d: scale up, handoff to ops, renewal readiness
```
Mike L (SE): Ack. I'll upload the dataset to the S3 bucket and post the link here when ready.
Natasha R (CedarTech): Targeting EOD Fri for dataset. Thanks all.
Sara (CS): Great. Next steps: Alex send invite; Mike request infra; Natasha deliver dataset. I'll follow up with a one-pager and checklist by tomorrow. :raised_hands:
